settings.title: Settings
settings.saveFailed: Could not save to the server. Your choice is kept on this device and will be sent again next time you open the app.
settings.pendingNotice: Some changes are not saved to the server yet; the app will send them next time it opens.

autoAccept.title: Auto accept invites
autoAccept.hint: Join projects and teams you are invited to without confirming each one.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.syncHint: On: use the same theme on all your devices. Off: change it on this device only.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.mismatch: Your device time zone ({{device}}) differs from your account time zone ({{account}}). Update it so "Today" is correct?

startPage.title: Start page
startPage.choose: Choose a project, label or filter…

smartDate.title: Smart date recognition
smartDate.hint: Detect dates and times as you type a task name in Quick Add.

swipeDelete.title: Delete task?
swipeDelete.message: The task "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
swipeDelete.messageWithSubtasks: The task "{{name}}" and its {{count}} sub-tasks will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

dateTime.nextWeekHint: The day the "Next week" shortcut picks in the date picker.
dateTime.weekendHint: The day the "This weekend" shortcut picks: the nearest such day after today (if today is that day, next week's).

navigation.intro: Choose 3 to 5 items for the tab bar. Browse always stays last. The tab bar is saved with your account.
navigation.pin: Pin a project, label or filter
navigation.pinHint: Only one item can be pinned.
navigation.full: The tab bar already has 5 items. Remove one first.
navigation.minimum: The tab bar needs at least 3 items.
navigation.restoreConfirmMessage: The tab bar goes back to Inbox, Today, Upcoming, Browse. This cannot be undone.
navigation.pinnedEmpty: Nothing is pinned yet. Pin a project, label or filter in Settings › Navigation.

picker.title: Choose an item
picker.empty: No projects, labels or filters yet

logoutAll.title: Log out of all devices
logoutAll.description: Ends every session, including this device.
logoutAll.confirmMessage: You will have to log in again on every device, including this one.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account and all your data (projects, tasks, labels, filters…). This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmMessage: All your data will be lost and this cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.
deleteAccount.passwordRequired: This account has no password yet. Set one first with "Forgot your password?" on the log in screen.

reset.title: Restore defaults
reset.description: Reset every setting to its default. Your time zone stays the same.
reset.confirmMessage: Theme, language, date & time, start page, swipe actions and tab bar go back to their defaults. This cannot be undone.
